requirements.title: Unified timeline view
requirements.description: Main dashboard displays chronological timeline of events from all registered domains. Events color-coded by domain. Expandable event cards show payload details.

validation.notes: API tests for timeline data aggregation

requirements.title: Per-domain sections
requirements.description: Dashboard includes collapsible sections for each registered domain showing domain-specific summary, recent events, and link to domain's deep-dive UI.

validation.notes: API tests for domain listing that powers domain sections

requirements.title: Trend charts
requirements.description: Dashboard includes configurable trend charts with 7d/30d/90d time windows. Line charts for continuous metrics, bar charts for discrete events. Domain comparison overlays.

validation.notes: API tests for timeline aggregation with configurable days parameter

requirements.title: Mobile-first responsive design
requirements.description: Dashboard designed mobile-first for phone-based daily brief consumption. Touch-friendly targets (44x44px minimum). Simplified mobile view prioritizes daily brief and Lifestyle Score. Full features on tablet/desktop.

validation.notes: UI implemented with responsive CSS using mobile-first breakpoints

requirements.title: Lifestyle Score display
requirements.description: Dashboard prominently displays daily 0-100 Lifestyle Score. Trend line showing score history. Tap to see domain breakdown. No gamification.

validation.notes: Tests score endpoint returns daily lifestyle score
Tests score increases with domain activity

requirements.title: Storage management settings
requirements.description: Settings page shows database size, large files breakdown. Actions: clean all data, clean selected domains, export data backup, import backup.

validation.notes: Tests storage info endpoint for settings page
Tests empty database returns valid storage info
Tests clear events from specific domain
Tests storage info includes per-domain event counts
